label: late-episode GO ramp scaled by S1 belief and last reward (esp. after a1 S1 r)
terms: (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) * belief ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) * (trial == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 65, 0, 20) * last_is("a2 S1 r")
explanation: Fires only at GO and only late in the episode (from ~trial 65, growing to trial 85+); D1/D2 are always 0. Its magnitude is a late-episode ramp L = clip(ep_trial-65,0,20) multiplied by observed history: it grows with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good, with a reward on the previous trial, and most of all after a1 S1 rewarded (common rewarded a1 - the agent will repeat a1); smaller boosts after a2 S1 unrewarded and on the window's first trial, and a reduction after a2 S1 rewarded. The bare ramp gets a negative weight, so late GO steps with S2 belief and no reward stay near 0. Every term is the ramp times an observed cue (no future, hidden or model-output variables). Additive phase tables cap at 0.19 (all) / 0.18 (all observed) because the effect is a time x history interaction; this 8-term interaction model reaches dev R^2 beyond timing 0.64, test 0.63 (timing alone 0.21). belief_cover added nothing. Compared with the earlier firing label (late GO after reward, choosing a1), belief plus last-trial pattern stand in for the a1 choice / policy without an obvious loss.

issues: The reported score reproduces: test R^2 beyond timing is 0.626 with the 8 claimed terms. Timing alone explains 0.207. The factual claims hold: the feature is 0 at D1 and D2 in every residual table; the GO residual rises steadily with belief decile (-0.049 to +0.083); after a1 S1 r the GO residual is +0.111, the largest of any previous-trial pattern.
One term does almost nothing: L*last_is('a1 S2 r') gets weight +0.002. With it and L*(trial==0) both dropped, the 6 remaining terms still score 0.626.

L*(trial==0) is mostly a window artifact, not a real effect. On a window's first trial the previous trial is unknown ('?'), so the last_is terms are all 0. The misses show first-step GO cells with actual about 1.07 against a predicted 0.28 to 0.37 inside long a1 S1 r runs. 'Raised on the window's first trial' is about the data window, not the agent.

Systematic gap: history two trials back matters and the model leaves it out. Example: at t98-t99, after an earlier unrewarded rare trial (a1 S2), the actual value is 0 even though the last trial was a1 S1 r, while the model predicts 0.52-0.68. Inside long a1 S1 r runs the model under-predicts the plateau (actual about 1.1, predicted about 0.68). Adding L*a1S1r*(reward two back is 1 or unknown) and L*a1S1r*belief raises test R^2 from 0.626 to 0.691. A two-trial a1 S1 r streak term alone gives +0.04 on dev.

The feature is also clearly active on some a2 choices: 0.4-0.6 at GO after a rare-rewarded a1 S2 trial. The firing label ('choosing a1') and the magnitude label do not mention this; the model under-predicts these cells (about 0.27).

'Keeps growing through trial 85 and later' overstates the ramp. The term is clipped at 85, and the activation looks saturated by about trial 85. Ramp shapes clip(ep_trial-68,0,12) and clip(ep_trial-70,0,15) fit about as well.

Ablations: L*belief alone scores 0.28 on test and L*prev_reward alone 0.17. Most of the score comes from the last-trial a1 S1 r interaction (0.41 dev with the ramp alone). 'Scaled by belief' is therefore a secondary effect, not the main driver.
skeptic.revised_label: Late-episode GO feature (from about trial 65, saturating by about 85), driven mainly by a recent run of a1 S1 rewarded trials and scaled up by the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good; an unrewarded trial two back suppresses it
